career_ladder.note: Canal Patwaris in the Irrigation & Water Resources Department and Revenue Patwaris in the Land Records Department of Haryana are vital field functionaries. Career advancement is regulated by the Haryana Irrigation Department Subordinate Services Rules and Haryana Land Revenue Rules.

steps.source_label: HSSC Advt No. 03/2023 (Group C Group 56 Graduate Level Posts) & Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules

steps.years: approx. 8-12 yrs (subject to Departmental Examination & merit)
steps.source_label: Haryana Land Revenue Subordinate Services Cadre Rules

exam_scheme.note: Patwari and Canal Patwari recruitments have been integrated into HSSC Group C CET under Group 56 (Graduate Level Posts). Shortlisted candidates from CET appear for the specialized Group 56 Mains Examination.

stages.stage_name: Common Eligibility Test (CET Group C Screening)
stages.source_label: HSSC CET Group C Notification & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Common Screening Examination (General Knowledge, Aptitude, Reasoning, Language & Haryana GK)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.95 deducted if fifth bubble unshaded
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying cutoff to be shortlisted for Group 56 Mains

stages.stage_name: HSSC Group 56 Mains Written Examination (Graduate Level Posts)
stages.source_label: HSSC Advt 03/2023 Syllabus for Group 56 (100 Questions, 97.5 Marks, 105 Minutes)

papers.paper_name: Subject-Specific Domain Knowledge (70% weightage: Land Revenue Administration, Canal & Drainage Act 1974, Irrigation Billing, Girdawari, Jamabandi, Disaster Management, Rural Governance)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; mandatory fifth bubble

papers.paper_name: General Awareness, Reasoning, Computer Literacy & Haryana History/Culture (30% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; mandatory fifth bubble

financial_package.note: Patwaris and Canal Patwaris are remunerated in Functional Pay Level 4 (FPL-4) under Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, with entry basic pay of ₹25,500.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 (FPL-4 scale ₹25,500 – ₹81,100)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry Level 4 basic pay of ₹25,500 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹14,790), House Rent Allowance (8% to 24%), Patwari Basta/Stationery allowance, and fixed medical allowance, minus standard employee NPS and insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) at prevailing state rates (58% effective 1 Jul 2025)
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by City Grade (X/Y/Z: 24%/16%/8%)
Stationery / Basta allowance for maintenance of land and canal records
Cashless Medical Facility under Haryana State Employees Scheme
New Pension Scheme (NPS) with state government matching contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Haryana Civil Services Rules

competition_benchmarks.note: Patwari and Canal Patwari positions are among the most sought-after field revenue appointments under HSSC Group C recruitment.
